title: model
description: An asset in its own local frame, placed by something else: a doodad, an item, a character, a building.

schema_version.description: Version of the schema this document conforms to.

space.description: Units and axes of every value in the document.

provenance.description: Who wrote it, when, from what.

definition.description: What exists and is valid for this model.

placement_sets.description: Placement sets this model owns: furniture, decorations, anything it places. Order is identity: selections index this list.

always_on.description: Shown wherever the model is placed, regardless of selection.

instance_count.description: Number of instances in the set.

customization.description: Customization options a character model offers, each with its valid choices.

category.description: The category the option is listed under.

geoset_id.description: Mesh geoset the choice shows; group * 100 + variant.

terrain.description: How a terrain tile meets its neighbours. Which tiles are neighbours is the world grid's fact, not the tile's.

edge_vertices.description: duplicated: a border vertex is stored by every tile it borders, at the same position in the world frame; heights agree to float precision unless the source tiles differ.

selection.description: What this model, as exported, has chosen from its definition.

placement_sets.description: Owned sets shown beyond the always-on ones.

references.description: Other documents this model depends on.

mesh.description: Triangle geometry: one shared vertex list, triangle indices, and the ranges that draw them.

colors.description: Vertex colour sets, u8x4 RGBA 0..255 as stored.

joints0.description: Skinning joint indices per vertex, u8x4.

indices.description: Triangle vertex indices, u32, three per triangle.

primitives.description: Index ranges drawn with one material.

geoset_id.description: Geoset the range belongs to: group * 100 + variant.

parts.description: Named, separately addressable pieces (rooms, wings, shells).

fog_volumes.description: Fog instances that apply inside the part, beyond the model's default fog, in source order.

ambient_particle_volumes.description: Ambient particle instances the part uses.

ambient_color_volumes.description: Ambient colour instances the part uses (point volumes, then box volumes).

to_part.description: The part on the other side.

unresolved.description: Fields whose meaning is not established.

portals.description: Polygons parts see each other through.

normal.description: Plane normal; dot(normal, p) + distance == 0 on the polygon.

unresolved.description: Fields whose meaning is not established.

extra_record.description: A 16-byte record attached to the portal, raw.

attributes.description: Per-element data with no dedicated field.

name.description: Channel name, '<source>.<field>', unique within the mesh.

domain.description: Which elements it covers: vertices, faces (one per triangle of indices, in order) or parts.

data.description: The values; count is the element count.

items.description: A liquid surface as a height grid over tiles; vertex (x, y) is at corner + (x, y) * tile_size with height heights[y * verts_x + x].

liquid_type.description: Liquid type; identity kind none when undecided.

heights.description: Vertex heights, f32, row-major, x fastest.

tile_exists.description: Per tile, 1 when liquid is present, u8.

collision.description: Triangles to collide with, with their own vertices.

indices.description: Triangle vertex indices, u32, three per triangle.

parents.description: Parent joint per joint, i32, -1 for a root.

bind_translation.description: Bind translation relative to the parent, f32x3.

billboard.description: How the joint faces the camera.

animation.description: Clips: per joint local transform curves for one sequence.

joints.description: Joints with curves in this clip.

rotation.description: Rotation curve, quaternion x, y, z, w.

materials.description: Materials; primitives refer to them by index.

items.description: One texture layer of a material.

role.description: What the layer contributes, e.g. diffuse, specular, emission.

uv.description: Texture coordinates it samples: uv_set_<n> or environment_mapped.

blend.description: How it combines with the layers below.

framebuffer_blend.description: How the result combines with what is already drawn.

scene.description: Objects the model places that are not geometry.

items.description: A point other models attach to.

bone.description: Joint the object moves with; identity is a record_index into the skeleton's joints.

position.description: Position in model space (not relative to the joint).

bone.description: Joint the object moves with; identity is a record_index into the skeleton's joints.

position.description: Position in model space (not relative to the joint).

items.description: A light attached to a joint, with animated colour and range.

kind.description: Light kind; unknown when the source type has no established meaning.

bone.description: Joint the object moves with; identity is a record_index into the skeleton's joints.

position.description: Position in model space (not relative to the joint).

attenuation_end.description: Distance where the light reaches zero.

items.description: A light placed in the model, not animated.

position.description: Position in model space (not relative to the joint).

rotation.description: Orientation, when stored as a quaternion.

euler_rotation.description: Orientation, when stored as Euler angles; axis order not established.

attenuated.description: Whether it falls off with distance.

attenuation_end.description: Distance where the light reaches zero.

inner_angle.description: Inner angle; half or whole cone not established.

cookie.description: Texture projected by the light; a cube map for point lights.

placement_set.description: Owned set the light switches with; absent means always on.

record.description: The source record this entry was decoded from.

default_fog.description: The fog instance a part's unlisted fog falls back to: the model's own default fog. Absent: the enclosing fog.

items.description: A ribbon trail emitted from a joint.

bone.description: Joint the object moves with; identity is a record_index into the skeleton's joints.

position.description: Position in model space (not relative to the joint).

texture_transform_lookup_index.description: Unresolved index into the source's texture transform lookup.

items.description: A particle emitter attached to a joint.

bone.description: Joint the object moves with; identity is a record_index into the skeleton's joints.

position.description: Position in model space (not relative to the joint).

textures.description: Textures, layer order; up to three.

child_emitters_model.description: Model whose emitters each particle carries.

multi_texture_scale.description: Scale of the extra texture layers.

color.description: Colour over the particle's life, [r, g, b] as stored (0..255 observed).

multi_texture_scroll_mid.description: Scroll midpoints of the extra layers.

multi_texture_scroll_range.description: Scroll ranges of the extra layers.

liquid_types.description: Each liquid type this document's liquids (terrain or geometry) name, once.

terrain.description: A heightfield surface: a grid of chunks, each a grid of quads, with texture layers, ground-cover rules and liquids.

row_axis.description: Unit direction rows step along, for chunks, vertices and alpha maps.

chunk_vertex_layout.description: Vertex order within a chunk: per row pair, 9 corner vertices then 8 quad-centre vertices, 145 in all.

chunk_topology.description: quad_centre_fan: each quad is four triangles around its centre vertex, counter-clockwise seen from +z; a hole quad has none.

textures.description: Ground textures; layers index this list.

repeats_per_chunk.description: Times the texture repeats across one chunk along each axis.

height_scale.description: Height-blend scale; 0 with height_offset 1 turns height blending off.

ground_effects.description: Ground-cover rules; layers index this list.

items.description: A ground-cover rule: the consumer scatters its doodads at runtime; nothing here is an instance.

density.description: Doodads per chunk, as stored; absolute scale unverified.

weight.description: Relative weight; use as a ratio.

chunks.description: The tile's chunks, index = row * chunks_per_side + column. Corner vertex (r, c) of a chunk sits at origin + (r * row_axis + c * column_axis) * quad_size; centre (r, c) at origin + ((r + 0.5) * row_axis + (c + 0.5) * column_axis) * quad_size.

origin.description: Per chunk, (x, y) of corner vertex (0, 0), f32x2.

heights.description: Per chunk, absolute height of each vertex in chunk_vertex_layout order, f32x145.

normals.description: Per vertex, unit normal, f32x3, 145 per chunk.

hole_rows.description: Per chunk, u8x8: bit c of byte r set means quad (r, c) draws nothing.

dominant_layer.description: Per chunk, u8x64 row-major: per quad, the layer whose ground effect applies. Bit order unverified.

ground_effect_suppressed_rows.description: Per chunk, u8x8: bit c of byte r set means no ground effect on quad (r, c). Bit order unverified.

liquid_fishable_rows.description: Per chunk, u8x8: bit c of byte r set means the liquid on quad (r, c) is fishable. Always within the chunk's liquid quads.

liquid_deep_rows.description: Per chunk, u8x8: bit c of byte r set means the liquid on quad (r, c) is deep (the source's fatigue flag). Always within the fishable quads.

area_index.description: Per chunk, u32: index into areas.

items.description: One texture layer of a chunk, bottom first.

direction.description: Scroll direction, counter-clockwise from +x seen from +z.

speed.description: Scroll speed step, 0..7; its unit is not established.

alpha.description: Layer weight over the chunk, u8, 64x64 row-major, rows stepping along row_axis; absent on layer 0, which covers what later layers leave.

liquid_objects.description: Each LiquidObject the liquids name, once. An id the client builds itself (42, the ocean, and others absent from the table) has only its identity.

identity.description: The LiquidObject row; a liquid's liquid_object equals one entry's identity.

flow_speed.description: Flow speed as stored; unit unverified.

items.description: A liquid surface over a rectangle of one chunk's quads. Vertex arrays are (width + 1) * (height + 1), row-major, rows stepping along row_axis.

chunk_row.description: Row of the chunk it lies in.

chunk_column.description: Column of the chunk it lies in.

quad_exists.description: Per covered quad, 1 when liquid is present, u8.

height_source.description: stored: heights were stored per vertex; min_height_level: none stored, flat at the instance's minimum; zero: a depth-only layout, drawn at 0.
